title: Verizon Recalls 2.5 Million Ellipsis Jetpack Mobile Hotspots Imported by Franklin Wireless Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium ion battery in the hotspots can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 2.5 million.

title: Epicure Recalls Glass Prep Bowls Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The tempered glass bowl can break or shatter during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 1,600 (In addition, about 5,250 units were sold in Canada).

title: Goal Zero Recalls Power Cables Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The pins inside the connector on the power cord can deform and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,850.

title: One Million Greenworks and Powerworks Pressure Washer Spray Guns Recalled Due to Impact Injury Hazard; Distributed by Hongkong Sun Rise Trading
summary: The spray gun connector can break, causing the hose and/or parts of the connector to become dislodged during use, posing an impact injury hazard to the user. Units: About 1.06 million.

title: RH Recalls Children's Bath Wraps Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The recalled bath wraps fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 55,700 (In addition, about 3,900 units were sold in Canada).

title: Infant Bath Seats Recalled Due to Drowning Hazard; Imported by BATTOP; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The bath seats fail to meet the federal safety standard for infant bath seats, including requirements for stability, and can tip over while in use, posing a drowning hazard to babies. Units: About 5,000.

title: Kawasaki USA Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel pump retainer plate bolts can come loose causing fuel leakage over time, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 70.

title: Kawasaki USA Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel pump retainer plate bolts can come loose causing fuel leakage over time, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 100.

title: YYBA Recalls Welmate Lidocaine Numbing Cream Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain relieving cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they put it on their skin or ingest it. Units: About 15,000.

title: BRAV USA Recalls Youth Jackets with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled jackets have a drawstring in the hood and a drawsting in the waist area that can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a strangulation and/or an entrapment hazard to children. Units: About 156.

title: Brompton Bicycle Recalls Electric Folding Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: Due to a software malfunction, the electric system can continue to provide assistance to the motor, causing continued forward momentum, when the rider is not actively pedalling, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 600.

title: Metal Ware Recalls NESCO Coffee Bean Roasters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The coffee bean roasters can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,350.

title: Audio-Technica Recalls Charging Cases Sold with Wireless Headphones Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The portable charging cases can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,450.

title: Battat Recalls Infant Teethers Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The plastic wings can detach from the body of the teether, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 61,000 (In addition, about 210 were sold in Canada).

title: Playgro Recalls Infant Activity Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The abacus ring on the horses back can dislodge and release the small beads, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 18,000.

title: Target Recalls Cat & Jack Baby Rompers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The heart-shaped graphics located on the knees of the romper can peel off or detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 44,350.

summary: The transceiver can switch modes unexpectedly when not locked or installed in the harness. title: Off-Road Motorcycles Recalled by American Honda Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The motorcycle's drive chain can break while in use, causing the vehicle to suddenly lose its drive force, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 536.

title: Pool Heaters Recalled by Pentair Water Pool and Spa Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A connection in the heater can leak the combustible air-gas mixture, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,700 (In addition, about 21 were sold in Canada).

title: Sauder Woodworking Recalls Counter Height Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The legs on the stools can become unstable over time, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,100.

title: UST Recalls Bottles of LifeSeasons Blood Nourish-R Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The product is a dietary supplement containing iron, which must be in child resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA).
